name: Snowdrop Voice Search
author: snowdropsignals

sections.description:
Snowdrop Voice Search helps WordPress posts and articles have a better chance of being found when people search by talking to Google, AI assistants, and smart devices.

It adds a short voice-search summary to each post and marks that summary with Speakable-style structured data.

In plain terms, when someone asks a question out loud, your post has a clear short section that explains what the article is about.

This clearer short section may help search and AI systems understand, surface, or reference your content more easily.

This first release is intentionally small and focused.

What it does:
– adds a Snowdrop Voice Summary field to posts
– shows that summary subtly on single post pages
– outputs simple Article schema on single post pages
– adds a SpeakableSpecification reference to the visible summary
– keeps the setup small and easy to remove

Best for:
– bloggers
– news sites
– small publishers
– magazine-style WordPress sites
– businesses with active blog content
– WooCommerce stores with an active blog

What it is not:
– a full SEO plugin
– a product page schema plugin
– a guarantee of rankings, traffic, citations, or sales
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/snowdrop-voice-search directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Open a post in the editor.
  4. Enter a short Snowdrop Voice Summary in the side panel.
  5. Publish or update the post.
sections.faq:
Does this replace my SEO plugin?

No. This is a small standalone helper plugin.

Does it work on product pages?

No. This first version is for WordPress posts only.

Does it automatically create the summary?

No. In this version, you add the summary manually.

Why does the summary appear on the post page?

The Speakable-style markup points to the visible summary section on the post page.

Will this increase rankings, traffic, citations, or sales?

No plugin can guarantee rankings, traffic, citations, or sales.

Is it easy to remove?

Yes. This version is designed to be simple and lightweight.

0.1.0

  • First public release.
  • Manual summary field for posts.
  • Front-end summary display on single posts.
  • Article schema output with SpeakableSpecification.
